title: Countable abelian closed inverse-image products with independent universes
statement: Let X and Z be schemes in universe t and i:Z -> X a closed immersion [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Set v=max(u,t+1). The inverse image of abelian sheaves [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], constructed as left Kan extension along the opposite pro-etale base-change functor followed by abelian sheafification, preserves limits of shape Discrete N with all abelian groups in universe v. In particular it commutes with countable products. There is no quasi-compactness or separation assumption on X or Z, and no relation between u and t.

source.place: Tag 09AA (lemma-closed-immersion), assertion (1); affine extra-left-adjoint input Tag 09BL.

proof.text: Instantiate the canonical left-Kan-extension/sheafification inverse image for RingCat and AddCommGrpCat in max u (t+1). For RingCat, supply the pointwise left Kan extensions by essential smallness of X.ProEt, local smallness of Z.ProEt, and cocompleteness of RingCat in that universe; supply sheafification via the essentially small site. Use the canonical sheaf adjunctions, with no change to the additive pullback in the conclusion.

Apply proEtale_immersion_algebraicInverse_limits to these two canonical adjunctions. A closed immersion is an immersion, so its abelian clause gives preservation of all limits indexed by categories with objects and arrows in universe zero. This existing coefficient-universe-independent theorem proves the affine henselian evaluation, Zariski-local restriction and transfer to algebraic structures needed by the original plan.

Specialize PreservesLimitsOfSize.{0,0} to Discrete Nat using preservesLimitsOfShape. This is precisely the required countable product preservation. Empty schemes and identity immersions are covered by the imported theorem without extra hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleClosedAbelianProductsOfUniverses
    {X Z : Scheme.{t}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ)
      (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (proEtaleBaseChange i)
        AddCommGrpCat.{max u (t + 1)} (ProEt.topology X) (ProEt.topology Z))
